name: Banana Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy. First add half the sugar, whisk, then add the other half
Add in eggs one at a time beating well after each addition
In a small bowl mix bananas, milk, cinnamon, and (optional) vanilla together
In another bowl mix all dry ingredients together until well incorporated
Add banana mixture to the butter mixture and whisk until well combined
Adding dry mixture 1/3 at a time, mix until well incorporated
Pour batter into pan and bake for 1 hour to 1 hr and 10 min
Poke with toothpick, if clean, pull out of oven
Transfer onto baking rack or just off pan to cool for 15 minutes
